name: @litma/desktop
description: Litma for Mac and Windows: the Litma web app in its own window, offline-first, with automatic updates.
author: Jayageetham

scripts.start: npm run build && node scripts/copy-web.mjs && electron .
scripts.dist: npm run build && node scripts/copy-web.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && node scripts/copy-web.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/copy-web.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win
